title: Immediate Cancellation of Northgate+ Annual: Refund Schedule and Member Confirmation
content:
**Scope.** For the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Annual membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships whose most recent settled annual fee was charged to an external card, and only for such a cancellation, the refund is worked out under this annual cancellation schedule.

**The member's decision.** The cancellation is the member's own decision; the member confirms it, the membership closes on the cancellation date, and the refund is credited to the external card the fee was charged to.

**When the refund is fixed.** The refund is fixed only after the membership's ledger carries the Northgate Cash earning of the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first, when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date and the line's earning under the consumer earning schedule comes to at least one cent.

The refund is not fixed until the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first has its Cash reversal on the membership's ledger, when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, which is the line's net amount times the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line, divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line. A line's net amount is the amount charged for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount.

**Refund basis recorded.** The refund is recorded with basis `full_within_window` when the fee was charged no more than the tier's annual full refund window days before the cancellation date, and with basis `prorated_unused_months` otherwise.

## Confirmation tool `confirm_annual_membership_cancellation_fe7f482c`

**Capability.** The member confirms, in person, the immediate cancellation of their own annual Northgate+ membership together with the refund of its annual fee. One call records the cancellation request as confirmed and closes the membership today (status canceled, auto-renew off, cancellation date today). When the refund is above 0.00 the call also books one refund entry against the annual fee charge, credited to the external debit or credit card that fee was charged to; when the refund is 0.00 it books no refund entry. The member sees the membership closed and, when a refund is booked, the refund on that card.

**Invocation.** This is a customer tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_annual_membership_cancellation_fe7f482c` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. The call succeeds when the receipt reports status "canceled".

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the membership identifier of the member's own membership record being cancelled, as returned by the membership lookup and read to the member by the agent |
| `original_event_id` | the ledger entry identifier of the annual fee charge the refund is booked against, as returned by the membership ledger lookup and read to the member by the agent |
| `refund_basis` | the basis the refund is booked under; one of `full_within_window` (the cancellation falls inside the annual fee's full refund window), `prorated_unused_months` (the cancellation falls after that window and the refund covers the unused months of the term), `billing_error` (the fee being refunded was charged in error: a second charge for the same billing period, or a charge for a period starting on or after a confirmed cancellation); `not_applicable` marks ledger entries that are not fee refunds and is refused on this refund |
| `refund_amount_usd` | the refund the member confirms, in US dollars with 2 decimal places, 0.00 or positive; values with more decimals or below 0.00 are refused, never rounded by the tool; with 0.00 the cancellation is recorded and no refund entry is booked |

**Return.** One of two text receipts. When the refund is above 0.00: "Membership <membership_id> canceled on <cancel_date>: request <request_ref> confirmed, refund <refund_ref> of <refund_amount_usd> USD against fee <original_event_id> with basis <refund_basis> credited to the external card, status canceled." When the refund is 0.00: "Membership <membership_id> canceled on <cancel_date>: request <request_ref> confirmed, refund none of 0.00 USD, no refund entry booked against fee <original_event_id>, status canceled." The cancellation date is today's date (YYYY-MM-DD), the request reference is the new request reference, the refund reference is the new refund entry reference and the amount is in two-decimal US dollars.

**Errors.** A text beginning "Error:" means nothing was changed because an argument broke the formats above or the membership reference is unknown.
